# Doctor Dave

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P49](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P54](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0054)</sub>

## Appearance

Doctor Dave is an elderly, large man with a white beard. He possesses a merry demeanor.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000)_

## Personality

Doctor Dave is a large, white-bearded elderly man known for his merry demeanor. However, he noticeably lacks tact, often bringing up sensitive topics like ropes in the homes of people who have committed suicide.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P54](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0054)_

## History

Doctor Dave engaged in a forty-year dispute with individuals from over the harbor. He later visited [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh at their new home alongside Mrs. Doctor Dave and Captain Saul, sharing an evening supper with them. During the gathering, he enjoyed listening to Captain Saul's stories and conversations before taking his leave with the other guests.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P16](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P34](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048), +3 more_
